title: Rightsizing / Workload drill-down
description: Why a workload got its recommendation: usage percentiles over the window, current and recommended requests/limits, throttling, OOM kills and automation events.

list.name: Automation events
list.expr: sum by (type, reason) (increase(kerf_actions_total{cluster="$cluster", namespace="$namespace", workload_kind="$kind", workload="$workload"}[2m])) > 0

list.name: datasource
list.label: Data source
list.description: Prometheus-compatible data source with the hub's VictoriaMetrics (or Prometheus).

list.name: window
list.label: Percentile window
list.description: Window of the P50/P95/P99/max lines. Profiles: dev 7d, production 14d, high-availability 28d.

panels.title: Monthly savings
panels.description: Estimated monthly savings of the selected containers (CPU + memory); negative = increase.

targets.expr: sum(max by (cluster, namespace, workload_kind, workload, container, resource) (kerf_recommendation_monthly_savings_usd{cluster="$cluster", namespace="$namespace", workload_kind="$kind", workload="$workload", container=~"$container"}))

panels.title: Confidence
panels.description: Recommendation confidence 0–1 = 0.6 × coverage + 0.2 × samples + 0.2 × stability. < 0.5 is flagged low-confidence; the agent applies at ≥ 0.7 by default.

targets.expr: max(kerf_recommendation_confidence{cluster="$cluster", namespace="$namespace", workload_kind="$kind", workload="$workload"})

panels.title: Data coverage
panels.description: Fraction of the recommendation window that has usage samples.

targets.expr: max(kerf_recommendation_data_coverage_ratio{cluster="$cluster", namespace="$namespace", workload_kind="$kind", workload="$workload"})

panels.title: Replicas
panels.description: Average number of running pods the hub used to compute savings.

targets.expr: max(kerf_recommendation_average_replicas{cluster="$cluster", namespace="$namespace", workload_kind="$kind", workload="$workload"})

panels.title: Recommendation age
panels.description: Time since the current recommendation was generated.

targets.expr: time() - max(kerf_recommendation_generated_timestamp_seconds{cluster="$cluster", namespace="$namespace", workload_kind="$kind", workload="$workload"})

panels.title: CPU mode
panels.description: Effective cpu mode (off / audit / auto-patch) as reported by the agent.

targets.expr:
(
  (max by (cluster, namespace, workload_kind, workload) (kerf_workload_mode{cluster="$cluster", namespace="$namespace", workload_kind="$kind", workload="$workload", resource="cpu", mode="auto-patch"}) == 1) * 2
  or (max by (cluster, namespace, workload_kind, workload) (kerf_workload_mode{cluster="$cluster", namespace="$namespace", workload_kind="$kind", workload="$workload", resource="cpu", mode="audit"}) == 1) * 1
  or (max by (cluster, namespace, workload_kind, workload) (kerf_workload_mode{cluster="$cluster", namespace="$namespace", workload_kind="$kind", workload="$workload", resource="cpu", mode="off"}) == 1) * 0
)

panels.title: Memory mode
panels.description: Effective memory mode (off / audit / auto-patch) as reported by the agent.

targets.expr:
(
  (max by (cluster, namespace, workload_kind, workload) (kerf_workload_mode{cluster="$cluster", namespace="$namespace", workload_kind="$kind", workload="$workload", resource="memory", mode="auto-patch"}) == 1) * 2
  or (max by (cluster, namespace, workload_kind, workload) (kerf_workload_mode{cluster="$cluster", namespace="$namespace", workload_kind="$kind", workload="$workload", resource="memory", mode="audit"}) == 1) * 1
  or (max by (cluster, namespace, workload_kind, workload) (kerf_workload_mode{cluster="$cluster", namespace="$namespace", workload_kind="$kind", workload="$workload", resource="memory", mode="off"}) == 1) * 0
)

panels.title: Phase
panels.description: Phase of the workload's RightsizingRecommendation: Pending → Applying → Applied, or Blocked / RolledBack / Released.

targets.expr:
(
  (max by (cluster, namespace, workload_kind, workload) (kerf_workload_phase{cluster="$cluster", namespace="$namespace", workload_kind="$kind", workload="$workload", phase="Released"}) == 1) * 5
  or (max by (cluster, namespace, workload_kind, workload) (kerf_workload_phase{cluster="$cluster", namespace="$namespace", workload_kind="$kind", workload="$workload", phase="RolledBack"}) == 1) * 4
  or (max by (cluster, namespace, workload_kind, workload) (kerf_workload_phase{cluster="$cluster", namespace="$namespace", workload_kind="$kind", workload="$workload", phase="Blocked"}) == 1) * 3
  or (max by (cluster, namespace, workload_kind, workload) (kerf_workload_phase{cluster="$cluster", namespace="$namespace", workload_kind="$kind", workload="$workload", phase="Applied"}) == 1) * 2
  or (max by (cluster, namespace, workload_kind, workload) (kerf_workload_phase{cluster="$cluster", namespace="$namespace", workload_kind="$kind", workload="$workload", phase="Applying"}) == 1) * 1
  or (max by (cluster, namespace, workload_kind, workload) (kerf_workload_phase{cluster="$cluster", namespace="$namespace", workload_kind="$kind", workload="$workload", phase="Pending"}) == 1) * 0
)

panels.title: CPU usage vs request, limit and recommendation
panels.description: CPU usage of the workload's pods (rate of container_cpu_usage_seconds_total; the hub uses the max across pods per step), current request/limit from kube-state-metrics, the hub's recommended values, and P50/P95/P99/max of the max-of-pods usage over the last $window (dotted, 5m resolution). Production uses P95 over 14d + 15 % headroom.

targets.expr:
max by (container) (
  sum by (cluster, namespace, pod, container) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{cluster="$cluster", namespace="$namespace", container=~"$container", container!="", container!="POD"}[$__rate_interval]))
  * on (cluster, namespace, pod) group_left ()
  (
  max by (cluster, namespace, pod) (
    label_replace(max_over_time(kube_pod_owner{cluster="$cluster", namespace="$namespace", owner_kind="ReplicaSet"}[$__rate_interval]), "replicaset", "$1", "owner_name", "(.*)")

    max by (cluster, namespace, replicaset) (max_over_time(kube_replicaset_owner{cluster="$cluster", namespace="$namespace", owner_kind="$kind", owner_name="$workload"}[$__rate_interval]))
  )
  or max by (cluster, namespace, pod) (
    label_replace(max_over_time(kube_pod_owner{cluster="$cluster", namespace="$namespace", owner_kind="Job"}[$__rate_interval]), "job_name", "$1", "owner_name", "(.*)")

panels.title: CPU throttling ratio
panels.description: Share of CFS periods in which the container was throttled (max across pods). Only containers with a CPU limit are throttled. Sustained throttling sets the throttled flag and blocks CPU decreases.

targets.expr:
max by (container) (
  sum by (cluster, namespace, pod, container) (rate(container_cpu_cfs_throttled_periods_total{cluster="$cluster", namespace="$namespace", container=~"$container", container!="", container!="POD"}[$__rate_interval]))
  / clamp_min(sum by (cluster, namespace, pod, container) (rate(container_cpu_cfs_periods_total{cluster="$cluster", namespace="$namespace", container=~"$container", container!="", container!="POD"}[$__rate_interval])), 1)
  * on (cluster, namespace, pod) group_left ()
  (
  max by (cluster, namespace, pod) (
    label_replace(max_over_time(kube_pod_owner{cluster="$cluster", namespace="$namespace", owner_kind="ReplicaSet"}[$__rate_interval]), "replicaset", "$1", "owner_name", "(.*)")
    * on (cluster, namespace, replicaset) group_left ()
    max by (cluster, namespace, replicaset) (max_over_time(kube_replicaset_owner{cluster="$cluster", namespace="$namespace", owner_kind="$kind", owner_name="$workload"}[$__rate_interval]))
  )
  or max by (cluster, namespace, pod) (
    label_replace(max_over_time(kube_pod_owner{cluster="$cluster", namespace="$namespace", owner_kind="Job"}[$__rate_interval]), "job_name", "$1", "owner_name", "(.*)")
    * on (cluster, namespace, job_name) group_left ()
    max by (cluster, namespace, job_name) (max_over_time(kube_job_owner{cluster="$cluster", namespace="$namespace", owner_kind="$kind", owner_name="$workload"}[$__rate_interval]))
  )
  or max by (cluster, namespace, pod) (max_over_time(kube_pod_owner{cluster="$cluster", namespace="$namespace", owner_kind="$kind", owner_name="$workload"}[$__rate_interval]))
)
)
